title: Notification stacking/grouping
line: A notification identical to an earlier one now replaces it instead of piling up in the popups and the history.
explanation: Every Notify call created a new entry, so an app repeating the same message (plasma-nm's "Connection deactivated" after a nightly router reset, a mouse's low-battery warning) stacked identical popups and history entries. The only existing guard drops an identical notification sent within one second, which never catches these. Now, when a new notification matches older ones from the same app (name, desktop entry, notifyrc, event, summary, body, icon, URLs and actions), the older ones are revoked (NotificationClosed reason 3, so the app knows) and only the new one is shown.

commits.message:
libnotificationmanager: Replace older identical notifications

When an app sent the same notification again, such as a connection that
drops every night, each copy stacked up in the popups and the history. A
new notification identical to older ones now revokes and replaces them.

BUG: 491181

media.caption: History after four identical "Connection 'Ethernet' deactivated" notifications: every copy is kept.
Same four notifications with the fix: one entry; the unrelated Konsole notification stays.
Popups while they arrive: identical copies stack on screen.
With the fix only the latest copy is on screen; the critical notification is untouched.
Different texts from the same app, or the same text from different apps, still show separately.
